items.headline: Rod Robinson II romps for 202 yards, 3 TDs and UAB topples Temple 36-10
items.description: — Rod Robinson II posted career highs of 202 yards rushing and three touchdowns, leading UAB to a 36-10 victory over Temple on Saturday.
